narr: An area of thunderstorms resulted in strong winds and areas of flash flooding in southern Cochise County.
ev: Numerous reports of flash flooding in the Bisbee area including mud and gravel over much of Brewery Ave making it impassable. Additionally, Green Bush Wash west of Bisbee flowed over roads and private properties. Public also reported approximately 1-3 inches of water flowing over Highway 92.
lsr: Photo on social media shows flash flooding over a road.
